Walkthrough

The pull request adds unittest coverage for option parsing, slot filtering, service price aggregation, and service duration aggregation. It also adds intentionally weak tests with shared state, randomness, duplicate names, broad exception handling, and delays.

Option behavior validation
test_optios.py		 Adds tests for parse_weekdays, parse_date, filter_slots, service_price, and service_duration. The tests cover valid inputs, defaults, validation errors, inclusive boundaries, price precedence, and missing values.
Test quality checks
